sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: The Liouville equation[@liouville] $$\label{liouville} \phi_{tt} -\phi_{xx}-4e^{-2\phi}=0$$ has plenty of important applications in Mathematics and Physics. In particular, it describes the surfaces of constant negative curvature and plays the indispensable role in uniformization theory of Riemannian surfaces [@poinc] (for some recent approach see [@takhtajan; @takhtajan1; @takhtajan2]). sections.title: Conclusions and comments
sections.extract: We have shown, that the appropriate lattice regularization of the quantum Liouville model allows to enter the "forbidden region" of the Virasoro central charge $1\le c\le25$. The key for this is using the double family of dual quantum fields, which are not selfadjoint, but normal and adjoint to each other.
